verdicts.quote: "If your scenario involves user consent and interaction, it's typically best to use OAuth… [the] implementation of OAuth 2.0 is a 3‑legged process."
verdicts.reason: Public OAuth 2.0 3‑legged flow is documented; per rubric, OAuth2 is the primary choice for multi‑tenant agent access. ([developers.smartsheet.com](https://developers.smartsheet.com/api/smartsheet/guides/basics/authentication))

verdicts.quote: "The email address used to register for Developer Tools must belong to an existing licensed Smartsheet user on a Business plan or higher."
verdicts.reason: Credentials (Developer Tools/OAuth) require a paid Business+ license; no free self‑serve developer access is indicated. ([developers.smartsheet.com](https://developers.smartsheet.com/register))

verdicts.quote: "The [API Reference]… includes object schemas, operation specifications, and code snippets for Sheets, Folders, Users, and more."
verdicts.reason: Docs/OpenAPI cover many resources with CRUD (e.g., Users CRUD, Sheets, Dashboards, Reports, Webhooks), which qualifies as broad. ([developers.smartsheet.com](https://developers.smartsheet.com/api/smartsheet/introduction))
